name: @kaicreator/domain-harness-compiler
description: Build-time compiler for DomainHarness Target Compiled Domain Packages

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const root='qualified-package/v09build/generated/'; fs.mkdirSync('dist/'+root,{recursive:true}); for (const name of ['acorn.mjs','acorn.d.mts']) fs.copyFileSync('src/'+root+name,'dist/'+root+name)"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
